events.title: Davin Youngs - THE RESET
events.description: Davin Youngs presents THE RESET, a live sound-bath performance combining music and meditation at the Phillips Center. Attend the scheduled session and check in at the venue. This is a ticketed event: UF student tickets are listed at $15, audience seating at $30, and on-stage seating at $40. Admission is not included with this quest. See the official event page for tickets and details: https://performingarts.ufl.edu/events/davin-youngs-the-reset/
events.locationName: Curtis M. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
